standard_position: 12-month performance warranty against explicitly defined functional specifications. The exclusive remedy is limited to 'repair or replace' functionality to mitigate cash-intensive settlement risks.
fallback_positions: A 90-day warranty coupled with a robust, commercially standard Support & Maintenance SLA (Service Level Agreement) to manage customer expectations over the long term.
red_line: A total exclusion of all warranties (e.g., 'Sold As-Is') in a high-value B2B purchase, as this lack of quality guarantee destroys customer trust and market position.
rationale: Product reliability and stability define the brand’s market reputation. Startups must guarantee functionality but avoid 'perfection' clauses that are technically impossible to fulfill.
negotiation_tips: Ambiguous promises like 'the software will be error-free,' which is an impossible legal standard that opens the company to endless frivolous breach-of-contract lawsuits.
